steps.title: Anesthetize and position mouse
steps.instruction: Place a 6‑10‑week‑old mouse in the acrylic chamber connected to an isoflurane vaporizer, deliver 3 % isoflurane in O₂ at 600 ml/min, and wait up to 3 min until fully anesthetized; then transfer the mouse to the heated immobilization pad, keep anesthesia with a facemask delivering the same isoflurane flow, and apply eye ointment to both eyes.

steps.title: Prepare surgical site
steps.instruction: Apply Nair to the chest area, wait 1–2 min, remove hair with a paper towel, swipe the area with Betadine, and sterilize with an alcohol pad; finally spread ultrasound gel on the chest.

steps.title: Set up ultrasound imaging
steps.instruction: Turn on the Vevo® 2100 system with the MS550 transducer (32–40 MHz), place the transducer directly above the gel‑covered chest, and locate the thymus in the live image.

steps.title: Load injection syringe
steps.instruction: Fill a 0.5 ml insulin syringe equipped with a 29G ½‑inch needle with 10–20 µl of NHS‑biotin (1 mg/ml in PBS) or the desired cell suspension, mount the syringe on the stand on the right side of the animal, and set the needle at an approximate 135° angle from the ground.

steps.title: Perform intra‑thymic injection
steps.instruction: Insert the needle tip into the ultrasound gel until it appears as a high‑density white dot, slide the syringe up/down to align the tip directly above the thymus, then pull the needle out of the gel, lower it, and advance through the ribs into the mouse while continuously monitoring the image until the tip is visualized inside the thymus; inject the volume, withdraw the needle, and immediately remove the gel with a cotton pad followed by an alcohol wipe.

steps.title: Post‑injection cleanup and recovery
steps.instruction: Remove the medical‑tape restraints, take the mouse off the nose cone, return it to its cage, and allow 2–3 min for recovery; the mouse should behave normally thereafter.

steps.title: Track recent thymic emigrants
steps.instruction: Euthanize the injected mouse 24–72 h later, collect the thymus in ice‑cold FACS buffer and the spleen in ice‑cold MACS buffer, mash each tissue with the plunger of a 3 ml syringe and pass through a 70 µm cell strainer, count cells with a hemacytometer, then process spleen cells as follows:

substeps.instruction: Resuspend spleen cells in 80 µl MACS buffer per 10⁷ cells.
Add 20 µl Anti‑Biotin MicroBeads per 10⁷ cells.
Wash with 2 ml MACS buffer per 10⁷ cells, centrifuge 300 × g for 10 min, and aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 500 µl MACS buffer up to 10⁸ cells.
Enrich biotin⁺ cells using LS columns according to the Miltenyi protocol.
Collect flow‑through and bound fractions and stain with streptavidin‑PE or streptavidin‑BV421 for flow cytometry.

steps.title: Prepare donor cells for transfer
steps.instruction: Sort iNKT progenitors from T‑betGFP/KN2 thymocytes, Treg progenitors from Foxp3‑GFP thymocytes, or purify DN thymocytes by LS‑column depletion of CD4⁺, CD8⁺, and CD4⁺CD8⁺ cells (B6 mice); then:

substeps.instruction: Wash the sorted/purified cells twice with 10 ml PBS, centrifuging 300 × g for 10 min each time.
Aspirate supernatant after the second wash.
Resuspend the cell pellet in ~20 µl PBS, keep on ice.

steps.title: Inject donor cells intra‑thymically
steps.instruction: Perform the intra‑thymic injection of the ~20 µl cell suspension exactly as described in the “Perform intra‑thymic injection” step (Procedure A).

steps.title: Collect and analyze recipient thymus
steps.instruction: At the experimentally determined endpoint, euthanize the recipient mouse, harvest the thymus into ice‑cold FACS buffer, mash with a 3 ml syringe plunger, filter through a 70 µm strainer, and analyze by flow cytometry using congenic markers (CD45.1, CD45.2) and any additional markers of interest.

steps.title: Prepare buffers
steps.instruction: Make the following buffers and store at 4 °C:

substeps.instruction: FACS buffer (≈10 ml per sample): 500 ml PBS + 2 % FBS + 0.02 % sodium azide.
ACK lysis buffer (≈5 ml per sample): dissolve 150 mM NH₄Cl, 10 mM KHCO₃, and 0.1 mM EDTA in 1 L ddH₂O, adjust pH to 7.2–7.4.
MACS buffer (≈30 ml per sample): mix 1 450 ml autoMACS Rinsing Solution with 75 ml MACS BSA Stock Solution.
